problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of F=f+ψ, with both summands convex and an attained minimum satisfying ‖x₀−x⋆‖≤R. No strong convexity is assumed.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The component f is continuously differentiable; ψ is convex, globally M-Lipschitz, and admits exact proximal minimization. ψ need not be differentiable.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: A query at x returns ∇f(x) exactly, independently of history and oracle randomness. No f-value query is supplied.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: Returns ψ(x) exactly. Gradient, proximal, and ψ-value queries each consume one call from the same fixed oracle budget.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For a>0, returns an exact global minimizer over E of ‖u−z‖²/(2a)+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u).

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x,y,S, if ‖∇f(x+θ(y−x))‖≤S for all θ∈[0,1], then ‖∇f(x)−∇f(y)‖≤(L₀+L₁S)‖x−y‖. The gradient is continuous; L₀,L₁>0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary real Hilbert space, without a finite-dimensional restriction. The nonsmooth term satisfies |ψ(x)−ψ(y)|≤M‖x−y‖, M≥0. E,L₀,L₁,M,x₀ are public; R>0 and ε>0 are hidden from algorithm construction and enter the execution budget. No initial objective-gap bound is supplied.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The returned point x∈E must satisfy (f+ψ)(x)−(f+ψ)(x⋆)≤ε for a global minimizer x⋆. No stationarity or distance accuracy is required.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law after execution with the fixed budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines gradient-dependent generalized smoothness with a globally Lipschitz nonsmooth composite term and an exact gradient/prox/ψ-value oracle in an arbitrary Hilbert space.
